claims.text: A Pod that does not set dnsPolicy gets ClusterFirst; 'Default' is not the default DNS policy.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Concepts > Services, Load Balancing, and Networking > DNS for Services and Pods > Pod's DNS Policy (Note: 'Default' is not the default DNS policy)

claims.text: With ClusterFirst the kubelet writes the Pod's /etc/resolv.conf: nameserver = cluster DNS, search = <namespace>.svc.cluster.local svc.cluster.local cluster.local, options ndots:5. Captured on donhang for network-lessons (no host search domains appended).
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: DNS for Services and Pods > Namespaces of Services / Pod's DNS Config example resolv.conf; examples/don-hang outputs/stage-3/scripts/k8s/dns-search.txt lines 1-4

claims.text: resolv.conf ndots:n: a name with fewer than n dots is tried with each search domain appended, in the order of the search line, before it is tried as written (captured on donhang); a name with at least n dots is tried as written first.
claims.source_hint: outputs/stage-3/scripts/k8s/dns-search.txt lines 6-11; kubernetes.io: DNS for Services and Pods > Pod's DNS Config (ndots); resolv.conf(5) options ndots:n

claims.text: A name with a final dot (e.g. example.com.) is treated as complete: no search domain is appended. Captured: getent ahostsv4 example.com. produces one query.
claims.source_hint: resolv.conf(5) man page, search (trailing dot = absolute name); outputs/stage-3/scripts/k8s/dns-search.txt lines 13-15

claims.text: On donhang one getent ahostsv4 example.com from client (ndots:5) produced, as logged by CoreDNS (type A only): example.com.network-lessons.svc.cluster.local., example.com.svc.cluster.local., example.com.cluster.local. each NXDOMAIN, then example.com. NOERROR.

Names under cluster.local are answered by CoreDNS's kubernetes plugin; a name there that matches no Service gets NXDOMAIN; other names such as example.com. are sent on by the forward plugin to the node's DNS servers.
claims.source_hint: coredns.io plugins/kubernetes (authoritative for its zones); plugins/forward; lesson k8s.l3.coredns claims 8 and 10; outputs/stage-3/scripts/k8s/dns-search.txt

claims.text: With ndots:5, the short name echo-ip (no dots) is first tried as echo-ip.network-lessons.svc.cluster.local, the Service's full name, which resolves on the first try. <service>.<namespace> (echo-ip.network-lessons) is how a Pod in another namespace names a Service.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: DNS for Services and Pods > Namespaces of Services (query 'data.prod'); outputs/stage-3/scripts/k8s/dns-search.txt line 32

claims.text: dns-search.sh adds the log plugin (after errors) to the Corefile in ConfigMap coredns, removes it on exit via trap; lookup runs getent ahostsv4 in the Pod and prints the queries for IPv4 addresses (type A) from that Pod's IP logged by the CoreDNS Pods since, with their answers.
CoreDNS's log plugin writes every query it receives to the log (standard output). getent ahostsv4 NAME resolves NAME to IPv4 addresses through the system resolver configuration.
Pod dns-ndots (dnsConfig.options ndots "1", no dnsPolicy) has 'options ndots:1' and needs one query for example.com: example.com. NOERROR.
dnsConfig options are merged into the resolv.conf generated from dnsPolicy (here ClusterFirst); an option's value is a string (dnsConfig.options[].value is type string).
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: DNS for Services and Pods > Pod's DNS Config (options: merged, duplicates removed); API reference PodDNSConfigOption (value: string)

claims.text: With ndots:1, a one-dot name such as echo-ip.network-lessons is tried as written first, and that query leaves the cluster (not under cluster.local, so the forward plugin sends it on).
claims.source_hint: follows from claims 3 and 6; review suggested_text

claims.text: When a Pod mostly calls outside names, a final dot or lower ndots saves queries; for Services in the same namespace the short name stays the simplest choice since its first try succeeds.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: DNS for Services and Pods (ndots, dnsConfig); outline item 4

claims.text: dnsPolicy: Default gives the Pod the node's name resolution settings; on donhang dns-node's resolv.conf has 'nameserver 192.168.65.254' and no search line, and getent hosts echo-ip finds no address, while the client Pod resolves echo-ip.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: DNS for Services and Pods > Pod's DNS Policy (Default: inherits name resolution configuration from the node); outputs/stage-3/scripts/k8s/dns-search.txt lines 26-32

claims.text: CoreDNS's cache is in the CoreDNS Pods, so each query still goes from the Pod to CoreDNS; on donhang 'cache 30' has 'disable success cluster.local' and 'disable denial cluster.local', so NXDOMAIN answers under cluster.local are not cached.
claims.source_hint: coredns.io plugins/cache (disable success|denial ZONES); outputs/stage-3/scripts/k8s/coredns.txt Corefile; lesson k8s.l3.coredns claim 12

claims.text: After the coredns ConfigMap is edited (here, adding the log plugin), the change can take up to two minutes to take effect (reload plugin).
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Customizing DNS Service > CoreDNS ConfigMap options (reload: allow two minutes); coredns.io plugins/reload (default interval 30s, jitter 15s)
